messages:
nina: Quick heads-up: my uncle is popping by at 4pm to drop off a vintage scrapbook for the office archive and a small potted fern. Hell only be 20-30 mins. Can we print a temp badge and a spot for him to sit?
frontdesk: Yep, we can print a visitor badge on arrival. Scrapbook flagged fragile — we'll ask courier/visitor not to leave it on the floor.
hiro: We have the low oak shelf by reception for fragile things, or we can use the small glass display case if you want it out of reach.
nina: Oak shelf is great, thanks. If the fern needs watering please put it on the window ledge (not the heater).
frontdesk: Will label items: "Nina - scrapbook" and "Nina - fern". Badge will be printed as "Visitor - Nina's Guest" and expire at 5pm.
badge-bot: temp badge created: "Visitor - Nina's Guest" (expires 17:00).
tom: Also FYI Im expecting a small priority envelope for marketing at 4:05pm. If it comes, leave it at the desk and tag "Tom - marketing".
frontdesk: Noted @tom. We'll place it in the small inbox slot.
nina: Seating: would the high-top by the kitchen be okay? It's quick and near the archive if he wants to sign.
hiro: High-top is good but it can be noisy. If he prefers quiet, the window bench is available.
nina: Hes old-school and might like quieter space. Window bench then.
frontdesk: Window bench reserved and sign placed. We'll print the badge and keep the scrapbook on the oak shelf.
tom: Poll: should we offer a cup of tea to the visitor? :tea:
nina: yes please
hiro: yes (and a coaster)
frontdesk: I'll offer tea and water, and put a coaster out.
frontdesk: Reminder to visitor: if scrapbook has loose pages, well keep it on the display case to avoid bending. See you all at 4pm."
